user.title: DoorCall Intercom
user.description: Doorbell rings become real calls on phones and tablets (app "Türklingel"). After setup, open "DoorCall" in the sidebar to set up doorbells, devices and groups.

abort.single_instance_allowed: DoorCall Intercom is already set up.

hausruf.name: Intercom call
hausruf.description: One device calls other devices in the home (no doorbell). The caller answers right away and leads; the others ring.

von.name: From
von.description: Calling device (notify service of the Home Assistant app, e.g. mobile_app_tablet_living_room).

an.name: To
an.description: Devices, "gruppe:NAME" or "alle" (all devices with the app). Default: all.

art.name: Mode
art.description: normal (as set on the device), laut (force volume) or durchstellen (targets answer automatically – only approved devices).

runde.name: Who answers
runde.description: alle (everyone keeps ringing, anyone can join) or einer (first to answer talks – the others stop ringing and get a quiet "join" notification).
